page.layout: One block: a ruled table of names in one column, grouped by horizontal rules, with a year printed beside each group in the right margin. A marginal note in the left margin.
page.notes: The year 1301 stands beside an empty group, with no names printed. A mark (a small leaf or hand sign) precedes "Allart Papinge" and "Alardus Papinge"; not transcribed. The years are printed in the right margin beside the rules. The left-margin note is set in small capitals with "VERONA" enlarged. The name "Butzel" has a long-tailed z-like letter in the scan, read here as z. "Ioannes" has a capital I as printed. No page number or running head is printed.
